notes: The two הוּא tokens are read differently because the ASV writes a pronoun for the second and not for the first: the resuming pronoun of the tripartite clause is the unrendered occurrence and the copula joins the nominal predicate (rules 20 and 22).

The flagged two-morpheme unit בְּחָכְמָה → *wisely* is retained: one English word stands for the preposition and its noun together, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is met and the unit heads on the noun (rule 40's closing paragraphs).
